description: Augmentation of Kolonnawa Grid Substation for the Development of 100 MW/100 MWh Battery Energy Storage System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been planned to establish Sri Lanka’s first utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System at the Kolonnawa Grid Substation in alignment with the Long Term Power Generation Expansion Plans.  Accordingly, approval was granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024 09 02, to upgrade the Kolonnawa Grid Substation for the development of 100 MW/100 MWh Battery Energy Storage Systems under the Power System Strengthening and Renewable Energy Integration Project, by utilizing the funds of the Asian Development Bank. Bids have been invited following the international competitive procurement method to select a contractor for the implementation of the said project and four bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Energy to award the said contract to Joint Venture of Ceylex Engineering (Pvt.) Ltd and Xingneng Electric Power Construction Co. Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest evaluated bidder, at a sum of USD 1.27 million, EUR 2.61 million and LKR 555.13 million (excluding VAT), based on the recommendation submitted by the High Level Procurement Committee after evaluating the said bids, was approved by the Cabinet.
